title: What We Believe
intro: Our faith is centered on Jesus Christ and expressed through worship, prayer, and service.

summaryCards.heading: Explore Episcopal beliefs
summaryCards.text: Read more about our shared faith on the Episcopal Church website.

sections.heading: Rooted in Christian faith
sections.text: As Episcopalians, we confess faith in God: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit. Scripture is the foundation of our faith, interpreted with the help of tradition and reason.

sections.heading: A life of prayer and worship
sections.text: The Book of Common Prayer shapes our shared worship. Baptism and Holy Communion are central to our life together.

sections.heading: Faith in daily life
sections.text: We seek to follow Jesus by loving our neighbors, serving others, and respecting the dignity of every person. Questions and learning are part of the journey.
